critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx hard-codes slice(0,4) on featured — either drop the slice (backend already curates to 8) or bump to slice(0,8). This is the single deviation between the review request and the running app.
New /api/health endpoint is minimal but sufficient (status + db-ping). Suitable for k8s liveness/readiness probes.

rca of the issue: Home 4-vs-8 featured mismatch: Home.jsx pipeline is `fetchProducts({featured:true}) → setFeatured → featured.slice(0,4).map(...)`. Backend curation dropped from 42→8 (correct on server); frontend slice was not updated to match, so only the first 4 of the 8 curated products render. One-line fix on /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx:181.
